entries.08ff772293efdc93: These are devices such as solenoid valves that switch the direction of compressed air flow. In January 1971 the company began manufacturing and selling direct-acting solenoid valves. Together with drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, these make up the product group that the company calls 'pneumatic equipment'. entries.17795620dd2d311e: This is the sole business segment of the SMC Group, which manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, component devices essential to factory automation (FA). Its products consist of pneumatic equipment, including directional control equipment, drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, as well as temperature control equipment and sensors, among others. These are component parts built into production and conveying lines of automated factories, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, industrial robots and other equipment. The company positions itself as a 'general manufacturer of pneumatic equipment' that makes and sells all equipment used on compressed air piping, and cites as its competitive advantage a range of 880,000 items and a short-lead-time, immediate-delivery system backed by ample inventory. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥842,541 million (up 6.4% year on year), production was ¥843,896 million (up 12.8%), orders received were ¥872,261 million (up 13.2%), order backlog was ¥118,156 million (up 33.6%), and the number of employees was 24,773 (temporary employees of 5,616 are not included).
